segment_contamination_dimensions: Modular tensile sub-segment (sibling MCAT 42328 'Modular Tensile Structure'): names emphasising modular, relocatable, or panel-based tensile systems are excluded — this MCAT covers custom-fabricated permanent/semi-permanent tensile structures, not modular kit-form systems.

Auditorium-specific tensile sub-segment (sibling MCAT 135861 'Auditorium Tensile Structure'): names exclusively targeting auditorium or indoor-hall tensile applications are excluded — this MCAT covers the broad outdoor roofing and canopy segment.

Gazebo-specific tensile sub-segment (sibling MCAT 136011 'Gazebo Tensile Structure'): names exclusively targeting gazebo or decorative garden pavilion tensile products are excluded — this MCAT covers functional roofing, parking, and commercial shade applications.

Tensile membrane structures sub-segment (sibling MCAT 135787 'Tensile Membrane Structures'): the exact phrase 'Tensile Membrane Structures' is excluded from enhanced name candidates to avoid direct name collision with the sibling MCAT.
